Class InstanceSession

java.lang.Object
io.github.protasm.jvmud.engine.instance.session.InstanceSession
public final class InstanceSession extends Object
Stable handle for one connection throughout login, Persona attachment and disconnect.

All mutable state belongs to InstanceSessions. This handle keeps no second actor, profile or attachment copy, so an LPC rebind is immediately visible to transport and engine callers holding the same handle. Read it on the owning instance's execution queue; transports enter through InstanceHost.
